g.text: US-03: Detection - Signal Loss via Scheduled Redis Scan
Unreadable timeline: no signal loss this scan.
Uninitialized authority: observed silence is 0 for every entity.
Gate first: a crash between the gate and the publish
loses this episode's alert rather than re-emitting it every scan.
Kafka publication can be replayed around failures.
Durable API persistence deduplicates by deterministic alert_id.
alert-state prevents normal repeated scan emission.
TTL expiry is not the detector.
